parsed.scene_description: A warehouse aisle lined with tall metal racks holding stacked red plastic crates. A forklift is parked on the right side of the aisle. Yellow safety posts are placed along the rack edges. The floor is concrete, and overhead lights illuminate the space. A red cart with wheels is visible in the distance down the aisle.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Stacked vertically on metal racks lining the left side of the aisle. Crates are bright red with ventilation holes and white labels. They are supported by the racks and partially occlude the view of the rack structure behind them.

objects.label: metal shelving racks
objects.observation: Tall, gray metal structures running along both sides of the aisle, supporting the red crates. Vertical posts and horizontal beams form the frame. Some yellow safety rails are attached to the top edges.

objects.label: yellow safety posts
objects.observation: Cylindrical yellow posts positioned at intervals along the base of the shelves on both sides of the aisle. They appear freestanding but are likely anchored to the floor. One is prominently visible in the foreground on the left.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Black and orange forklift parked on the right side of the aisle, facing away from the camera. Its forks are raised slightly. The brand 'PPECKE TAK' is visible on its side. It rests directly on the concrete floor.

objects.label: red wheeled cart
objects.observation: Red cart with wheels located in the center of the aisle, further down the passage. It has a rectangular shape with a silver horizontal bar near the middle. It sits on the concrete floor, appearing stationary.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Smooth, light-gray concrete surface extending throughout the aisle. It provides a flat base for the racks, forklift, and cart. Reflections of overhead lights are visible on its surface.

objects.label: overhead lighting fixtures
objects.observation: White fluorescent lights mounted on the ceiling, illuminating the aisle. Two are clearly visible, casting even light across the scene. They are suspended from the ceiling structure.
